citations.quote: Hospitalisation: Admission to a hospital as an inpatient for at least 24 consecutive hours on a doctor's advice.
Inpatient hospitalisation: We pay for room, nursing, surgery, doctors' fees, tests and medicines during hospitalisation (HLTH-DEF-1.1), subject to HLTH-EXC-4.1 and HLTH-CON-5.1.
Road ambulance: We pay up to Rs 3,000 per hospitalisation for road ambulance transport to hospital, when the hospitalisation is covered under HLTH-COV-2.1.
